qualitative.filing_summary_10q: For the 36 weeks ended May 10, 2026, Costco reported net sales of $203,374 million and membership fees of $4,057 million, totaling revenue of $207,431 million, with net income of $6,228 million, up from $5,489 million in the comparable prior-year period. Total assets grew to $86,430 million from $77,099 million at fiscal year-end August 31, 2025, and cash and cash equivalents increased to $18,946 million. The company paid cash dividends of $1,806 million declared during the period and repurchased $603 million of common stock, while also reporting increases in merchandise inventories and accounts payable.
